tooltip_fire_bomb: Kills 40 soldiers in 1 city next to your land. An emptied city becomes yours.
tooltip_bombardment: Kills 40 soldiers in each of 2 cities next to your land. Emptied cities become yours.
tooltip_soldier_spell: Brings 40 soldiers to one of your cities.
tooltip_mega_bomba: Kills 60 soldiers in each of 3 cities next to your land. Emptied cities become yours.
tooltip_atom_bomb: Hits anywhere: kills 80 soldiers in each of 4 cities. Emptied cities become yours.
tooltip_nuclear_bomb: Hits anywhere: kills 100 soldiers in each of 6 cities. Emptied cities become yours.
tooltip_tribute: Tap a city of another player and take 200 of their diamonds.
error_no_card: You have no such card. Draw one or buy it in the Weapon Shop.
error_invalid_attack: Soldiers can only go to a neighbouring city, and at least 2 must be in the city.
error_invalid_target: This card cannot be used there. Pick a city with an orange line.
shop_tank_desc: Adds +25 strength to one attack a turn.
tutorial_step_map: Africa is divided into cities; the region around each city belongs to it. An army's land has a thick line in its colour around it. A bigger city ball means more soldiers; tap a city to see how many. You start with 4 blue cities in Morocco, with 3 bots nearby. Pinch to zoom and drag to move the map.
tutorial_step_territory: To attack, hold the soldiers of your city and drag them to a neighbouring city; they march there and fight. Each tank joins one attack per turn and adds +25 strength; it is lost if the attack fails. Drag to your own city to move soldiers.
tutorial_step_resources: At the end of every turn you earn 80 diamonds and each of your cities gets 5 soldiers. A diamond mine pays 250, a gold mine (capitals with a yellow ring) 150 diamonds. Forest cities are harder to take.
tutorial_step_abilities: Bomb cards kill soldiers and an emptied city becomes yours: Fire Bomb 40 in 1 city, Bombardment 40 in 2, Super Blast 60 in 3. Atom Bomb (80 in 4 cities) and Nuclear Bomb (100 in 6) hit anywhere on the map. Tribute takes 200 diamonds from a player. Tap the card, then the city. Every turn Draw Card gives you a free card.
tutorial_step_shop: The Weapon Shop at the side sells every card, tanks and bombers. Press Bomber and tap a city: a bomber flies there and kills 15 soldiers. Each bomber flies once per turn.
tutorial_step_end_turn: When you are done, End Turn. The bots play one after another and fight each other too. With two players, pass the phone to the next player.
tutorial_step_victory: Wipe every other army off the map and conquer Africa.
hint_select_territory: Tap a city to see it.

difficulty_title: How strong should the bots be?
difficulty_hard_desc: Bots go for mines and use all their cards and bombers.
